description: Laura Cabo discusses her high-profile career as an architect, initially working for traditional firms and, more recently, for The Walt Disney Company. After receiving her Master of Architecture degree, she began her career at RTKL in Baltimore working on large-scale design projects. Moving to Boston, she began a successful 20-plus year career with Gund Partnership, where she led the design and construction of many notable buildings. Focusing design, collaboration and storytelling as key tools in creating projects, she explains how she developed an expertise in arts and cultural buildings. While at Gund, she worked with Disney's Wing Chao on numerous projects.  Eventually, she left Gund to become an Architectural Design Studio Executive with The Walt Disney Company, becoming a leader in the architecture and design of Disney theme parks and resorts around the world. In 2018, she became a Portfolio Creative Executive for The Walt Disney Imagineering, designing a new class of Disney Cruise Lines ships. Laura discusses her commitment to design excellence, mentoring her staff, collaboration, and fostering out-of-the-box, creative storytelling at Disney Imagineering.
